mark_scheme:
(a) $y = \operatorname{arcosh} x = \ln(x + \sqrt{x^2 - 1})$ $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}u}(\ln u) = \frac{1}{u}$ or $e^{y} = x + \sqrt{(x^2 - 1)}$
